items.title: Italy's Liguria Region
items.summary: Discover Italy's beautiful Liguria region, part of the Italian Riviera, offering a lovely family travel experience. This northern Italian area is known for its quiet charm.

items.title: West African Cuisine at Restaurant Kwagies
items.summary: Experience the rich flavors and vibrant culture of West African cuisine. They offer authentic dishes, a special West African buffet every two weeks on Sundays, and daily lunch and dinner buffets.
items.dateHint: Sundays every two weeks for special buffet; daily for lunch/dinner buffets

items.title: BACKFISCHFEST (CITY FESTIVAL)
items.summary: Experience the largest wine and folk festival on the Rhine in Worms, featuring the traditional Worms Fishermen’s Guild. Enjoy nine days of extraordinary activity, food, and wine.

items.title: BARBAROSSA-FEST “SWINGING LAUTERN”
items.summary: Enjoy live shows, marching bands, and shop to jazz, swing, blues, and rock 'n' roll in Kaiserslautern city center. This festival offers a top-notch program with regional and international bands.

items.title: KUSELER MESS
items.summary: Enjoy carnival rides, attractions, booths with food and various products, and live music at this fair. Highlights include a festival parade, Sunday shopping, family day with reduced prices, and fireworks.

items.title: Mainzer Weinmarkt im Stadtpark
items.summary: Visit one of Germany's most beautiful wine festivals in Mainz City Park, offering fine wines, food stalls, and live music amidst old trees and romantic avenues. A perfect blend of wine culture and a relaxed atmosphere.

items.title: PUMPKIN EXHIBITION “Dinosaurs”
items.summary: Explore 11 unique dinosaur art installations made from 40,000 pumpkins at Neumühlepark/Gartenschau. Famous dinosaurs like Diplodocus and Triceratops are featured in various pumpkin colors.

items.title: Dog Obedience Training
items.summary: Kaiserslautern Outdoor Recreation offers dog obedience training for dogs starting at eight weeks old, held on Saturdays at Pulaski Barracks. Classes are one hour and cost $15 per dog.

items.title: FANTOBER: The Hunger Games Scavenger Hunt
items.summary: Participate in a month-long scavenger hunt across Smith Barracks, completing tasks at designated facilities to earn a raffle ticket for a Panem Prize Pack.

items.title: Kaiserslautern’s End of Summer Car Show
items.summary: A car show open to all military-affiliated ID card holders, featuring five categories for judging and prizes. Pulaski Auto Skills will also be open for services.

items.title: Latin Nights at the Rheinlander!
items.summary: Enjoy Latin Night on the last Friday of every month with live music from The Salsa Band Borinkuba. Food is available, and the event is for ID card holders aged 18 and older.

items.title: SKIES Gymnastics
items.summary: Enrollment is open for SKIES Unlimited gymnastics for ages 1 to 18 in the Kaiserslautern Community. Open to all ID card holders from all branches of service.

items.title: Hitscherhof Pumpkin Season
items.summary: Enjoy pumpkin specialities, a cornfield maze, straw castle, and bouncy castle for kids at Hitscherhof, open weekends until the end of October.
items.dateHint: Sept. 12+13, then every Saturday and Sunday until the end of October

items.title: Cars 25th Anniversary Re-release
items.summary: Celebrate with the Cars 25th Anniversary Re-release, a perfect opportunity to enjoy this classic animated film on the big screen.

items.title: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer’s Stone 25th Anniversary Re-release
items.summary: Experience the magic again with the Harry Potter and the Sorcerer’s Stone 25th Anniversary Re-release, a special screening for fans of all ages.

items.title: Paw Patrol: The Dino Movie
items.summary: Take the kids to see Paw Patrol: The Dino Movie, where the pups get stranded on a tropical island with dinosaurs and must save Rex's home from a volcanic eruption.

items.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
items.summary: Catch Spider-Man: Brand New Day, where Peter Parker faces intensified demands and a physical evolution while protecting New York City from powerful new threats.
